ei.title: Enchanting Trips down the Romantic Road / Rural Adventures

fullPassage:
Are you looking for the perfect destination for romantic holidays? Then look no further than the Romantic Road in southern Germany. This trail is a favorite among tourists from all over the world. The history of the Romantic Road dates back to the Roman Empire, as it was originally built for trade and transportation. After being destroyed during World War II, the road and the surrounding cities were reconstructed. The result was the Romantic Road, which was derived from the name "Roman Road." Today it attracts tons of visitors every year. I want to share with you three amazing spots I visited while on the Romantic Road.
"If I could choose my place of birth, I would consider Würzburg," wrote the renowned author Hermann Hesse. It's easy to see why after taking a stroll around the charming, medieval town. Upon arrival, the two towers of St. Kilian Cathedral welcome you. And within a five-minute walk of the towers, the Würzburg Residence, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, will be on full display with Court Gardens and Residence Square. This beautiful palace was built by the most prominent architects and artists of the 18th century from Austria, France, Italy, and Germany. But the beauty of the city doesn't stop there. For a more relaxing experience, take a stroll along the banks of the Main and watch the sun set behind the skyline. It's an excellent photo spot, so I took some during the sunset.
If you're planning a trip to Würzburg in early summer, then count yourself lucky! Every year, the city transforms into a giant party scene in celebration of the great classical composer Wolfgang Mozart. From the Imperial Hall of the Würzburg Residence to the Court Gardens, you can enjoy Mozart's classical music, performed by some of the best symphony orchestras in the world. With over 60 concerts, including free pop-up street performances, you'll enjoy Mozart's charming sound all over the city. The grand architecture's reflection on the river, the lively markets in the town squares, and the beautiful music of the street performers combine to create a truly enchanting experience.
Get ready for a journey through time! Our next stop is Rothenburg, a fortified city that sits on top of the deep river valley of the Tauber. Rothenburg ob der Tauber, which translates to "Red Castle above the Tauber," is named for its position overlooking the river. The town boasts medieval architecture and half-timbered houses that create a truly unique atmosphere. To fully immerse yourself in this charming location, you can take a relaxed stroll through the colorful houses. If you happen to visit during the Christmas season, you will have the chance to shop for adorable ornaments and other unique items at Rothenburg's Christmas market.
When looking for a sweet treat during your travels in Germany, try a Schneeball in Rothenburg. The Schneeball, whose name means "snowball" in English, is a deep-fried pastry that has been popular for over 500 years. I like the classic icing sugar flavor, but other choices include chocolate, caramel, or fruit-filled. Whatever you choose, it's important to know a Schneeball is tricky to break open. So, you'll need to use a wooden hammer to break through the crust. It used to be served only on special occasions like weddings, but now you can find it year-round in pastry shops and cafes. It can be messy to eat, but that's all part of the fun. Don't miss this signature treat during your visit!
Füssen, in southern Germany, is the final stop on the Romantic Road. It is an attractive old town at the foot of the Alps with the Lech running right through it. Füssen is the perfect place to take a rest after traveling along the road, which is exactly what I did when I discovered an open-air spa. The breathtaking views surrounding me made the experience even more delightful. However, the real highlight of Füssen was the world-famous Neuschwanstein Castle. Situated on top of a hill, the castle provides magnificent views. It has inspired castle depictions in animations such as Sleeping Beauty and Cinderella. The castle was built by King Ludwig II, a great supporter of the celebrated composer Richard Wagner. It is worth noting that the name "Neuschwanstein," meaning "New Swan Castle," is derived from the Knight of the Swan legend, which inspired an opera by Wagner.
As we come to the end of our journey on the Romantic Road, I hope you've enjoyed traveling with me. The Romantic Road offers a unique blend of history, culture, and outstanding natural beauty that will leave you with unforgettable memories, whatever the next stop of your travels may be. Remember, life is a journey, and every journey begins with a single step. Take that step today and consider exploring the Romantic Road!
Agritourism is an increasingly popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life, connect with nature, and learn about the agricultural industry. It provides tourists with an amazing experience and a fun educational opportunity they cannot have in cities. It also gives valuable insights into the history and culture of farming and the importance of sustainable agriculture. Most tourists spend time visiting farm stands, picking fruit, or feeding animals. Others may navigate a corn maze, stay on a farm, or help with farm chores. In addition to providing fun activities for tourists, agritourism has become a necessary means of survival for many small farms today. This is because agritourism activities can take place at times of the year when crops are not in season. By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a stable income regardless of the seasons. Some studies have found that agritourism operations also benefit the surrounding communities by attracting tourists to the area. The economic boost from increased traffic can be good for the entire rural community.

questions.passage: The history of the Romantic Road ①<u>dates</u> back to the Roman Empire, as it was originally built for trade and transportation. After being ②<u>destroyed</u> during World War II, the road and the surrounding cities were ③<u>reconstructing</u>. The result was the Romantic Road, which was ④<u>derived</u> from the name "Roman Road."
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 도로와 주변 도시가 ③재건되었다(reconstructed).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ reconstructing → reconstructed: 'were + p.p.' 수동태 구문이므로 과거분사 필요
❌ ① dates: 3인칭 단수 현재 적절
❌ ② destroyed: being + p.p. 수동태 적절
❌ ④ derived: was derived from 수동태 적절
det.tip: were + p.p. = 수동태. reconstructing(현재분사) ≠ reconstructed(과거분사)

questions.passage: The Schneeball, ①<u>who</u> name means "snowball" in English, is a deep-fried pastry that has been popular for over 500 years. Whatever you choose, it's important ②<u>to know</u> a Schneeball is tricky to break open. It used to be ③<u>served</u> only on special occasions like weddings, but now you can ④<u>find</u> it year-round in pastry shops.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: Schneeball, ①whose name은 영어로 'snowball'을 의미한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① who → whose: 소유격 관계대명사 필요 (name = Schneeball's name)
❌ ② to know: it's important to V 구문 적절
❌ ③ served: used to be served 수동태 적절
❌ ④ find: can find 적절
det.tip: whose = 소유격 관계대명사. whose name = ~의 이름

questions.passage: Füssen is the perfect place to take a rest after ①<u>traveling</u> along the road, which is exactly ②<u>what</u> I did when I discovered an open-air spa. The breathtaking views ③<u>surrounding</u> me made the experience even more delightful. However, the real highlight of Füssen was the world-famous Neuschwanstein Castle, ④<u>situating</u> on top of a hill.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 언덕 꼭대기에 ④위치한(situated) 성이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ situating → situated: 성이 '위치해 있는' 것이므로 수동 의미의 과거분사 필요
❌ ① traveling: after + ~ing 적절
❌ ② what: 선행사 포함 관계대명사 적절
❌ ③ surrounding: 전망이 능동적으로 둘러싸므로 현재분사 적절
det.tip: situated(위치한) = 수동 의미 과거분사. situating은 능동(~을 위치시키는)

questions.passage: It is worth ①<u>noting</u> that the name "Neuschwanstein," ②<u>meant</u> "New Swan Castle," is derived from the Knight of the Swan legend, ③<u>which</u> inspired an opera by Wagner. The Romantic Road offers a unique blend of history, culture, and outstanding natural beauty that will ④<u>leave</u> you with unforgettable memories.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: "New Swan Castle"을 ②의미하는(meaning) "Neuschwanstein"이라는 이름은...
det.analysis:
✅ ② meant → meaning: 현재분사가 필요. 이름이 능동적으로 '의미하는' 것이므로 meaning
❌ ① noting: be worth ~ing 적절
❌ ③ which: 계속적 용법 관계대명사 적절
❌ ④ leave: will leave 미래 시제 적절
det.tip: meaning(현재분사, 능동) = ~을 의미하는. meant(과거분사)는 수동('의미되어진')으로 부적합

questions.passage: Are you looking for the perfect destination for romantic holidays? Then look no further than the Romantic Road in southern Germany. This trail is a favorite among tourists from all over the world. I want to share with you three amazing spots I visited while on the Romantic Road. As we come to the end of our journey on the Romantic Road, I hope you've enjoyed traveling with me. The Romantic Road offers a unique blend of __________ that will leave you with unforgettable memories, whatever the next stop of your travels may be. Remember, life is a journey, and every journey begins with a single step.
questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: Romantic Road는 역사, 문화, 뛰어난 자연미(history, culture, and outstanding natural beauty)의 독특한 조화를 제공한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ history, culture, and outstanding natural beauty: 글 전체에서 역사적 도시, 문화 축제, 자연 경관을 소개
❌ ① modern technology: 중세/역사 중심 → 현대 기술 무관
❌ ② trade and commerce: 과거 무역 언급이나 현재 핵심이 아님
❌ ④ hotels and restaurants: 숙박·식당 정보 아님
det.tip: 결론부 = 글 전체 요약. Romantic Road의 3대 매력: 역사 + 문화 + 자연

det.korean: 농촌 관광은 많은 소규모 농장의 필수 생존 수단(a necessary means of survival for many small farms)이 되었다.

❌ ① expensive souvenirs: 비싼 기념품 구매는 핵심 아님

❌ ③ European wars: 전쟁 역사 학습과 무관
det.tip: This is because ~ → 빈칸 뒤 이유가 나옴. 비수기 소득 → 생존 수단

questions.passage: Upon arrival, the two towers of St. Kilian Cathedral welcome you. questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.analysis:

❌ ① 17세기 → 18세기 (the 18th century)
❌ ③ 이탈리아만 → Austria, France, Italy, Germany 4개국
❌ ④ 폐허 → on full display(전시 중)

questions.passage: The real highlight of Füssen was the world-famous Neuschwanstein Castle. Situated on top of a hill, the castle provides magnificent views. It has inspired castle depictions in animations such as Sleeping Beauty and Cinderella. The castle was built by King Ludwig II, a great supporter of the celebrated composer Richard Wagner. det.korean: ③ 성은 Wagner가 설계한 것이 아니라 Ludwig II가 지었다.

❌ ①②④: 원문과 일치

questions.passage: ① Agritourism is an increasingly popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life. ② It provides tourists with an amazing experience and a fun educational opportunity they cannot have in cities. ③ Most tourists spend time visiting farm stands, picking fruit, or feeding animals, though these activities are only available in major cities. ④ Some studies have found that agritourism operations also benefit the surrounding communities by attracting tourists to the area.
questions.stem: ①~④ 중 글의 흐름상 내용이 틀린 문장은?

det.korean: ③에서 '이 활동들은 대도시에서만 가능하다'는 것은 농촌 관광의 본질과 모순됩니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ only available in major cities → 원문은 농촌에서 하는 활동. ②에서 'cannot have in cities'라 했으므로 모순
❌ ①②④: 원문 내용과 일치
det.tip: 원문 핵심: 농촌 관광 = 도시에서 할 수 없는 경험. '대도시에서만 가능'은 반대

questions.passage: The history of the Romantic Road dates back to the Roman Empire, as it was originally built for trade and transportation. After being destroyed during World War II, the road and the surrounding cities were reconstructed. The result was the Romantic Road, which was derived from the name "Roman Road." questions.stem:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 위 글에서 **영어**로 찾아 쓰시오.

"After the war, the cities along the road were __________ and became a famous tourist route."

※ 대소문자 구분 없음

det.korean: 전쟁 후 도로를 따라 있는 도시들이 재건되어(reconstructed) 유명한 관광 코스가 되었다.
det.analysis: destroyed → reconstructed → tourist route. 'After the war' = 'After being destroyed during World War II' (패러프레이징)
det.tip: reconstruct = re(다시) + construct(짓다) = 재건하다

questions.passage: Füssen is the perfect place to take a rest after traveling along the road. The breathtaking views __________ (surround) me made the experience even more delightful.
questions.stem: 다음 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: 나를 둘러싼(surrounding) 숨막히는 전경이 경험을 더 즐겁게 만들었다.
det.analysis: surround → surrounding: 현재분사가 views를 수식 (능동: 전경이 나를 둘러싸는)
det.tip: surrounding = 현재분사(능동). views가 능동적으로 '둘러싸는' 주체

ch: 독일 남부 로맨틱 가도의 매력적인 관광지와 역사·문화
유럽 전역의 중세 성곽 건축 양식 비교
세계대전이 유럽 관광 산업에 미친 영향
questions.passage: Are you looking for the perfect destination for romantic holidays? Then look no further than the Romantic Road in southern Germany. This trail is a favorite among tourists from all over the world. I want to share with you three amazing spots I visited while on the Romantic Road. "If I could choose my place of birth, I would consider Würzburg." Get ready for a journey through time! Our next stop is Rothenburg. Füssen, in southern Germany, is the final stop on the Romantic Road. The Romantic Road offers a unique blend of history, culture, and outstanding natural beauty.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 독일 남부 로맨틱 가도의 매력적인 관광지와 역사·문화가 글의 주제이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 로맨틱 가도의 관광지와 역사·문화: Würzburg, Rothenburg, Füssen 3개 도시 + 역사·문화·자연 소개
❌ ② 중세 성곽 비교: 비교가 아닌 소개
❌ ③ 조리법: Schneeball 언급이 있으나 조리법은 아님
❌ ④ 세계대전 영향: 배경일 뿐 주제 아님
det.tip: 주제 = 글 전체를 관통하는 핵심. Romantic Road + 3개 도시 + 역사·문화·자연

questions.passage: Agritourism is an increasingly popular form of travel that allows tourists to experience rural life. In addition to providing fun activities for tourists, agritourism has become a necessary means of survival for many small farms today. This is because agritourism activities can take place at times of the year when crops are not in season. By adding new business operations, farm operators are able to ensure a stable income regardless of the seasons. The economic boost from increased traffic can be good for the entire rural community.
questions.stem:
위 글의 요약문으로 빈칸 (A)와 (B)에 들어갈 말의 조합으로 적절한 것은?

"Agritourism helps small farms earn a (A)__________ income (B)__________ of seasonal changes, while also benefiting rural communities."

det.korean: 농촌 관광은 소규모 농장이 계절 변화에 (B)관계없이(regardless) (A)안정적인(stable) 수입을 올리는 데 도움을 준다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② stable–regardless: 원문 'ensure a stable income regardless of the seasons' 그대로
❌ ① expensive–limited: 비싸고 제한된 수입 → 문맥과 반대
❌ ③ temporary–dependent: 임시적이고 의존적 → 문맥과 반대
❌ ④ declining–because: 감소하고 때문에 → 문맥과 반대
det.tip: stable income regardless of seasons = 계절에 관계없는 안정적 수입

questions.passage: The Schneeball, whose name means "snowball" in English, is a deep-fried pastry that has been popular for over 500 years. Whatever you choose, it's important to know a Schneeball is tricky to break open. So, you'll need to use a wooden hammer to break through the crust. It can be messy to eat, but that's all part of the fun.
questions.stem:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 알맞은 영어를 위 글의 내용을 바탕으로 쓰시오.

"Because a Schneeball is difficult to open, you must use a __________ to crack its outer shell."

※ 대소문자 구분 없음

det.korean: Schneeball은 열기 어렵기 때문에 나무 망치(wooden hammer)를 사용해야 한다.
det.analysis:
tricky to break open → difficult to open (패러프레이징)
use a wooden hammer to break through the crust → use a __________ to crack its outer shell
det.tip: wooden hammer = 나무 망치. tricky ≒ difficult, crust ≒ outer shell
